title: Enumeration and Monotonicity of Linear Codes with Prescribed Hull Dimensions
summary: The hull of a linear code is the intersection of the code with its dual and depends on the choice of inner product. We study how the numbers of linear codes with prescribed Euclidean, Hermitian, and symplectic hull dimensions vary with the hull dimension. Building on closed enumeration formulae, we derive exact ratio decompositions for the Hermitian and symplectic cases, determine the parameter ranges in which monotonicity holds, and identify the exceptional families. We also compare the three inner products and complement the theoretical analysis with computational classification results…
